name: WittyBluray
summary: Blu-ray images with their menus, including 4K, HDR and 3D discs.
updates: All of the engine: playlists and clips, running a disc's program and its Java programs, reading menus and subtitles; and a Blu-ray's page: its sections in every app, why a playlist is the film, and the names given to its playlists and chapters, kept in its own database.
stays: Drawing menus into pictures stays with the server, and so does refusing encrypted discs and checking what the engine says, on purpose. The session code that turns steps into streams stays too. Which playlist is a disc's film, and an administrator's choice of another, are kept with the server's copy of the disc.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
Java, only for discs with Java menus, and only if you turn that on
